title: I really like the app
body:
It’s been over 365 days since (pun intended 🤣) I got the Days Since app, and I really like it! I used to use calendar apps for countdowns, but I prefer Days Since because it offers a more solid visual countdown. Watching the timer run from seconds to minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, and years refreshes me and encourages me to keep going.

There was a time I had to reset (sadly), but as soon as the seconds started counting again, I felt encouraged. Each second counts and is worth celebrating. Even 5 seconds of not relapsing is better than staying stuck.

I’ve had many resets, but each one has contributed to my growth and improvement. I appreciate that the app records the number of resets because it provides a realistic measure of progress. Seeing those resets helps me make peace with past falls and shows that I’m growing, rather than denying that they happened.

The app isn’t just for tracking bad habits; I use it to track things like my plant’s age and my relationship’s anniversary, too.

I’d love to see the app add a feature for counting down days to future events as well.
